display.title: Frankfurter exchange-rate API
display.summary: Query ECB reference rates, currencies, and historical time series without an API key; this collection covers the still-available v1.

documentation.stabilityNote: Read-only public API without authentication. v1 is superseded by v2 but remains available long term; its catalog endpoints are marked deprecated.

pricing.summary: The public API is free for commercial use with no monthly or daily quota; upstream rate-limits requests to prevent abuse.
pricing.freeTier: No API key and no API-call fee.
